description: This file implements the 'git reset' command as a C source code file, containing command logic, argument parsing, index manipulation, and repository state updates.

methods.name: int reset_index(const char * ref,const struct object_id * oid,int reset_type,int quiet)
methods.description: Performs a reset of the index to match a specified tree or commit, supporting different reset types like soft, mixed, hard, merge, and keep.

methods.name: void print_new_head_line(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Outputs information indicating the new HEAD position after a reset.

methods.name: void update_index_from_diff(struct diff_queue_struct * q,struct diff_options * opt UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Updates the index entries based on a diff queue, used during resetting to a specific tree state.

methods.name: int read_from_tree(const struct pathspec * pathspec,struct object_id * tree_oid,int intent_to_add)
methods.description: Reads a tree object and updates the index to match it, optionally marking files as intent-to-add.

methods.name: void set_reflog_message(struct strbuf * sb,const char * action,const char * rev)
methods.description: Prepares a reflog message for updating references during reset.

methods.name: void die_if_unmerged_cache(int reset_type)
methods.description: Aborts if the index is in a merge state, preventing resets during mergers.

methods.name: void parse_args(struct pathspec * pathspec,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,int patch_mode,const char ** rev_ret)
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the reset command, determining the revision, paths, and modes.

methods.name: int reset_refs(const char * rev,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Updates the repository's HEAD and ORIG_HEAD references to new commits or trees.

methods.name: int git_reset_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Reads configuration options affecting the reset command.

methods.name: int cmd_reset(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git reset' command, orchestrating argument parsing, state resets, and repository updates.
